'''Arcadia''' was the second [[Planet/Legends|planet]] orbiting the orange giant [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Sacorria (star)|Sacorria]] in the [[Sacorrian system]], located in the [[Outlier systems]] of the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]] within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. Arcadia was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] rock with one [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="CW" />

==Behind the scenes==
All worlds in the [[Sacorrian system]], except [[Sacorria]], were designed for the [[2003]] sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CW" /> Later, the [[2009]] sourcebook ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the Sacorrian star system in grid square M-11.<ref name="EAOC" />
